headline: Starling is working with Nvidia on a transactional model hosted in a UK sovereign cloud
body: Starling is working with Nvidia to build a transactional foundational model that is trained and hosted within a UK sovereign cloud. Finextra reports Starling as the first bank to train an AI model on UK sovereign cloud.
note: Where a bank trains and hosts a model is becoming part of the AI story for lenders, alongside what the model does.

evidence.text: Starling is working with AI chip making giant Nvidia to build a transactional foundational model that is trained and hosted within a UK sovereign cloud.
Starling becomes first bank to train AI model on UK sovereign cloud
